comment: The single source of truth for what `pnpm test:mutation` mutates. Both
stryker.config.mjs (which mutates every `source`) and
jest.mutation.config.ts (which runs every `tests` entry, and nothing else)
are derived from this file, and src/tests/mutation-scope.test.ts fails
`pnpm test` if either drifts from it or if a path listed here has been
renamed away. A mutate glob that matches nothing is otherwise a line in a
log and a mutation score that goes up.
Admission rule: every dependency a module has arrives as an argument — no
clock read, no `process.env`, no module-scope connection pool, nothing
ambient. That is the property that makes a surviving mutant mean a missing
assertion: a unit test can put the module in any state it likes, so there
is no mutant it was unable to reach. `sendByteRange` qualifies on that
rule even though it writes a response, because the response and the byte
source are both parameters. A module that opens its own pool does not, and
listing one would move the threshold rather than the tests.
`tests` is deliberately only the module's own unit suite. A mutant killed
incidentally by an end-to-end test through `createApp()` is near-zero
evidence that the unit suite pins the behaviour down, and running the whole
suite against each of ~1000 mutants costs about 40x what running the one
suite does: 1h25m against 8 minutes, measured.

modules.why: Proactive content negotiation (RFC 9110 §12.5.1): q-value parsing and specificity ordering, string in and a choice out.
The 206/416/304 response contract. Both of its effects — the byte source and the response — are parameters, so a suite drives the whole contract with neither storage nor a socket.
Precondition evaluation order for If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since and If-Range: a pure decision over parsed header values.
Entity-tag grammar plus strong and weak comparison, which differ in exactly one place the parser must not blur.
Range parsing and resolution against a known size: overflow clamping and unsatisfiable detection, all arithmetic.
Retry-After in both of its grammars; the HTTP-date branch takes the reference instant as a parameter rather than reading a clock.
If-Match / If-None-Match list parsing and the version-to-ETag mapping optimistic concurrency is denominated in.
Which precondition failure a request earns — 428 for a missing If-Match, 412 for a stale one — is a decision over the parsed value.
Opaque cursor encode/decode and page assembly; the decoder is an input boundary with nothing but arithmetic behind it.
